## Ziff Davis to Participate in Two Investor Conferences in December


November 17, 2026


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Ziff Davis, Inc. (NASDAQ: ZD), today announced its participation in two investor conferences in December.


Details of the conferences are as follows:


**UBS Global Technology and AI Conference**


Location: Scottsdale, AZ


Date and time: December 2, 2026


Webcast: No formal presentation


**Susquehanna Technology Select Spotlight Series**


Location: Virtual


Date and time: December 15 - 16, 2026


Webcast: No formal presentation


**About Ziff Davis**


Ziff Davis (NASDAQ: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, health and wellness, cybersecurity, and martech. For more information, visit[www.ziffdavis.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.ziffdavis.com&esheet=54642055&newsitemid=20261117494660&lan=en-US&anchor=www.ziffdavis.com&index=1&md5=52fb835ac947f64058dd336952642cd3) .
